name: Mage Ai
description: Build, run, and manage data pipelines for integrating and transforming data.
composeYaml:
services:
  mage-ai:
    image: 'mageai/mageai:0.9.78'
    command: 'mage start default_project'
    environment:
      - PROJECT_NAME=default_project
      - USER_CODE_PATH=/home/src/default_project
      - ENV=production
    volumes:
      - 'mageai_data:/home/src/'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-s'
        - '-f'
        - '-o'
        - /dev/null
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:6789'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
